mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with alprazolam (benzodiazepine) increases CNS depression and carries theoretical risk of hypertensive crisis or serotonin syndrome, particularly if benzodiazepine is metabolized via monoamine pathways.
action: Concurrent use requires careful monitoring; if combination is necessary, use lowest effective doses and monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and vital sign changes; benzodiazepines are not absolutely contraindicated with MAOIs but demand close clinical supervision.
